headline: Islanders’ Pageau out with lower-body injury, Maccelli, Pulock return to lineup
take: The Islanders get two players back and lose one, Daily Faceoff reports: Jean-Gabriel Pageau is out with a lower-body injury, while Ryan Pulock and Matias Maccelli return to the lineup. Pageau has a goal and seven assists in 17 games. The returns matter more than the box score suggests, because New York's record has been carried by its net. The Islanders are 8-6-4 but have had only 46% of the expected goals (the quality of chances), and they've allowed 12.2 fewer goals than the chances against them deserved. A defenceman like Pulock is the kind of help that could ease that dependence. Losing Pageau, a long-time defensive center, cuts the other way.
